questions.title: How much time can you give to learning?

options.label: 15–20 minutes a few times a week
More — I want to learn fast

pace.light: One lesson a week. Each lesson takes about 7–10 minutes, and you can stop at any point: your progress is saved.
pace.steady: Two or three lessons a week, plus one practice exercise after each lesson.
pace.intense: One lesson a day. Do a practice exercise after each lesson.
